steps.label: Container level
steps.sub: Per-container CPU/memory, down to one container in a pod

eyebrow: Pods stuck in a bad state
code:
KubePodInventory
| where ClusterName == "my-aks-cluster"
| where PodStatus in ("Failed", "Pending")
| summarize count() by Namespace, PodStatus, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
caption: A real rollout health check — which namespaces are stuck, hour by hour.

code:
Perf
| where ObjectName == "K8SContainer" and CounterName == "cpuUsageNanoCores"
| where InstanceName contains "checkout-service"
| summarize avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| render timechart
caption: Same summarize/bin/render pattern from Lesson 2 — now scoped to InstanceName.

eyebrow: Live Data and the FinOps tradeoff
code:
# Live Data: real-time pod logs, events, exec access
# in the portal — no local kubectl session required.

# But: ContainerLogV2 + high-cardinality Perf data
# are a top driver of Log Analytics ingestion cost.
# Data collection rules (DCRs) scope what's collected
# by namespace, log level, or container.
caption: "More monitoring" and "lower cost" pull in opposite directions on the same dial.
